Name: ClosetOtaku's Slime Plushies for DGA
Author: zenychan
Description:
[center]Adds slime plushies in 7 colours. You can get them from the furniture catalog or from the Adventurer's Guild for 100g, a different colour every day of the week!
The available colours are:
[color=#9900ff]Purple[/color][color=#674ea7] [/color]- [color=#6d9eeb]Blue [/color]- [color=#ffe599]Yellow [/color]- [color=#93c47d]Green [/color]- [color=#b45f06]Copper [/color]- [color=#999999]Slate[/color][color=#b6b6b6] [/color]- [color=#cc0000]Red﻿[/color][/center][center]
[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/99/aa/7iGMdJ9L_o.png[/img]

Original mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7300][color=#9fc5e8]here[/color][/url]﻿. All credit for sprites goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83901383][color=#9fc5e8]ClosetOtaku[/color][/url]﻿. I just slightly altered the image to make the plushies centered and also added a Turkish translation.
